description: Search Reddit for recent posts matching given keywords. Returns structured results with post metadata, subreddit approval status, and age.

keywords.description: Keywords to search for (e.g. ["freelance contract", "NDA template"])

maxPostAgeHours.description: Only return posts newer than this many hours. Default: 24.

subreddits.description: Optional: specific subreddits to search within. If omitted, searches all of Reddit.

name: search_reddit
